challenge.method: Compare an ordinary global operator of an extended module, an operator marked LOCAL directly, and definitions from a LOCAL INSTANCE made in that module. Check the ordinary and local sets in the general module semantics, the direct examples in the local-definitions subsection, and the text's separate treatment of inheritance and instance statements.
challenge.results: The extender obtains ordinary global definitions through GDef. Local declarations of operators and the locally instantiated definitions stay in LDef and are unavailable through that extension. The same pages distinguish this restriction from inherited declarations and assumptions, and explain that LOCAL cannot qualify an EXTENDS statement. The boundary supports the exact scoped statement.

limitations: The claim describes definition visibility in the exact author reference. The book handles inherited declarations, assumptions, conflict conditions, and instantiation or substitution under separate rules.
A definition originating from a LOCAL INSTANCE is usable in the module containing the instance. Whether another module has a distinct definition of the same name is a separate question.
The June version date is the cover's text date. The imprint describes the first printing as July 2002, and the author identifies July 2021 as the PDF recreation.
